visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Sub-band of visual-tree section rc6 (#page > div.SNR_section.section:nth-of-type(3)); two halves side by side: blue pill 'Subscribe to AT&T News' button left, outlined search input with magnifier right.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Inline newsroom search bar with a magnifier submit button
visualCharacteristics.description: Inline outlined search bar with magnifier icon, sits beside a CTA in a split section

contentPattern.structure: one cell with a link to the search source (a query-index .json filters in place; any other URL is a results page submitted with ?q=) and the placeholder text as a separate paragraph. Key/value rows (source | url, placeholder | text) also work

usage: Beside the Subscribe CTA in a split section on the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for any single-input site/newsroom search.
